title: Shu original tea-street architectural surfaces
author: Codex, authored for Shu
method: Original native SVG vector construction; deterministic brush shapes and curves; no raster image generation or third-party artwork
license: Original project art; same use and distribution terms as Shu project art. No additional third-party asset license.
status: implementation candidate; rendered asset review only, in-scene and user visual acceptance pending

texture_usage.albedo_modulation: Use white (#ffffff) for authored palette, or very restrained warm/cool modulation. Existing saturated dark material colors would double-tint and crush details.
texture_usage.roof-gray-teal.svg: 16 narrow barrel-tile columns by 8 tiers per repeat. X goes across ridges; Y goes from ridge toward eave. Initial target repeat footprint: width 2.4 m, slope 2.4 m (each tile approx 0.15 m wide, 0.3 m slope length); adapt to authored roof proportions.
texture_usage.plaster-ivory.svg: One repeat per approximately 2.5 m wall patch. Mottling is intentionally very low contrast; do not increase contrast to make it look textured.
texture_usage.timber-honey.svg: Grain runs along image Y. One repeat approximately 0.5 m across grain and 2.5 m along grain. Rotate UVs for horizontal beams.
texture_usage.flagstone-graygreen.svg: Four unequal 128 px courses, three unequal stones per course. One repeat approximately 2.4 m square gives 0.6 m courses; initial path repeat can use 2.0-2.4 m square.
